rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken expression for the Mediterranean region and its surrounding countries.

example.english: We’re planning to travel around the Mediterranean region.
example.traditional: 我哋計劃去地中海一帶旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 heoi3 dei6 zung1 hoi2 jat1 daai3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this when referring more formally or precisely to the Mediterranean geographical region.

example.english: The Mediterranean region includes Southern Europe, North Africa, and West Asia.
example.traditional: 地中海地區包括南歐、北非以及西亞。
example.jyutping: dei6 zung1 hoi2 dei6 keoi1 baau1 gwaat3 naam4 au1 bak1 fei1 ji5 kap6 sai1 aa3
